lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Port Halden, 2148. The sea took the first two storeys and then stopped, level, as though it had been allocated exactly that much and no more.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What is left is roof gardens, rope bridges between chimney stacks, and the noise water makes in a stairwell that goes down further than anyone has been.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Came through here as a kid, with a crew, going south. There were more roofs then. People used to live four or five to a block up here.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Not now. Look at the lines. Half of them aren't tied to anything at the far end.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Nine million people lived in this city in 2064. The Enclave census for this entire coast in my century is forty thousand.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The archive does not say where the rest went. It does not say they died, either. It simply stops counting them, quarter by quarter, until the number is small enough to be correct.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Then we are standing in the difference. Eight and a half million people, and this is the room they are in.
